title: Redundant Connection
oneLinerQuestion: Find an edge that can be removed to turn a graph back into an unrooted tree.
explanation: Process edges sequentially. Edge [1, 5] merges node 5 into the component. Subsequent edge [1, 4] completes cycle 1-2-3-4-1.
pseudoCode:
FUNCTION findRedundantConnection(edges):
    parent = [i FOR i FROM 0 TO LENGTH(edges)]
    FUNCTION find(n):
        p = parent[n]
        WHILE p != parent[p] DO parent[p] = parent[parent[p]]; p = parent[p]
        RETURN p
    END FUNCTION
    FUNCTION union(n1, n2):
        p1, p2 = find(n1), find(n2)
        IF p1 == p2 THEN RETURN False
        parent[p1] = p2; RETURN True
    END FUNCTION
    FOR n1, n2 IN edges DO:
        IF NOT union(n1, n2) THEN RETURN [n1, n2]
    END FOR
END FUNCTION
